args.rationale: No management-approved security policy; board has not discussed cyber risk in 12 months; no board member trained.
args.gap: No approval of measures, no oversight, no management training.
args.recommendation: Have the board formally approve the security policy and risk register, add a recurring cyber agenda item (at least quarterly), and run documented cybersecurity training for all board members within 90 days.

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-20 (not_implemented). 11 control(s) remaining.

args.rationale: A risk register of 16 risks exists and a draft guideline was written, but neither is approved and the register has no treatment plan.
args.gap: No approved policy; risk register unapproved and without treatment plan.
args.recommendation: Finalise and have management approve the information security policy; approve the risk register and create a treatment plan with owners and deadlines; review annually.

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-21a (partially_implemented). 10 control(s) remaining.

args.rationale: CloudTrail (90 days) and CloudWatch logs exist, but nobody reviews them, there are no security alerts, and no written IR plan or roles exist; handling is ad hoc in Slack.
args.gap: No detection alerting, no IR plan, no roles, no analysis/containment process.
args.recommendation: Write an incident response plan with roles and severity classification; enable GuardDuty and CloudWatch/CloudTrail security alarms routed to an on-call person; extend log retention to at least 12 months; run a tabletop exercise.

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-21b (partially_implemented). 9 control(s) remaining.

args.rationale: Daily snapshots (14 days) and multi-AZ DB exist, but restores are untested, no RPO/RTO, no DR plan for region outage, and no out-of-band crisis communication.
args.gap: No tested restore, RPO/RTO, DR plan, or crisis management.
args.recommendation: Define RPO/RTO, perform and document a restore test now and at least twice a year, add cross-region backup copies, write a DR/BCP plan and crisis communication plan with an out-of-band channel.

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-21c (partially_implemented). 8 control(s) remaining.

args.rationale: Suppliers are chosen on price and features; no security questionnaires, no contract clauses beyond AWS standard terms, no critical supplier list.
args.gap: No supplier security assessment or management.
args.recommendation: Build a critical-supplier inventory, introduce a security questionnaire and minimum contract clauses (incident notification, DPA), and review critical suppliers annually.

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-21d (not_implemented). 7 control(s) remaining.

args.rationale: Peer review of PRs, a 2024 pentest and monthly image rebuilds exist, but no SAST/DAST/dependency scanning, no secure-coding guideline, pentest fixes not retested, no vulnerability scanner, irregular manual patching, and no disclosure process evidenced.
args.gap: Weak SDLC security, no vulnerability scanning, irregular patching, no disclosure policy.
args.recommendation: Add SAST and dependency scanning to CI/CD, adopt a secure-coding guideline, deploy a vulnerability scanner (e.g. Amazon Inspector) with patch SLAs, retest the 2024 findings, and publish a vulnerability disclosure policy (security.txt).

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-21e (partially_implemented). 6 control(s) remaining.

args.rationale: No metrics/KPIs and no internal audit; only a single 2024 pentest, not retested, which is not a programme.
args.recommendation: Define a small set of KPIs (patch latency, MFA coverage, restore test results, training completion), report them quarterly to the board, schedule an annual internal audit and yearly pentest with retest.

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-21f (not_implemented). 5 control(s) remaining.

args.rationale: Onboarding video and ~70% MDM with disk encryption exist, but no refresher or phishing simulation, contractors use uncontrolled personal devices, no EDR.
args.gap: No recurring training; incomplete endpoint hygiene.
args.recommendation: Introduce annual training with phishing simulations, enrol all devices in MDM (or ban unmanaged devices for contractors), and deploy EDR.

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-21g (partially_implemented). 4 control(s) remaining.

args.rationale: TLS 1.2+ and KMS-managed keys are in place, but there is no written policy, KMS uses defaults, and default encryption is not enabled on all S3 buckets.
args.gap: No cryptography policy; inconsistent encryption at rest.
args.recommendation: Write a cryptography policy (algorithms, key lifecycle, rotation), enable default encryption on all S3 buckets via AWS Config rule, and enable KMS key rotation.

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-21h (partially_implemented). 3 control(s) remaining.

args.rationale: A partial asset spreadsheet exists, but it is stale and omits cloud resources and owners; no offboarding checklist (leaver kept access 3 months), no access reviews, shared admin user and over-broad admin roles.
args.gap: Weak joiner/mover/leaver, access review, least privilege, and asset inventory.
args.recommendation: Create an offboarding checklist with same-day revocation, remove shared admin user and replace AdministratorAccess with least-privilege roles, perform quarterly access reviews, and build an asset inventory covering cloud resources with owners.

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-21i (partially_implemented). 2 control(s) remaining.

args.rationale: MFA enforced on Google Workspace SSO, but not on AWS root, customers have no MFA, and there is no emergency communication channel.
args.gap: No MFA on AWS root/admin; no customer MFA; no emergency comms.
args.recommendation: Enable MFA on the AWS root and all IAM/SSO users immediately, offer TOTP/WebAuthn MFA to customers and strengthen password rules, and set up an out-of-band emergency channel (e.g. Signal group, phone tree).

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-21j (partially_implemented). 1 control(s) remaining.

args.rationale: The team is unaware of the 24h/72h deadlines and has no written IR plan or roles; no evidence of a reporting procedure or CSIRT contact.
args.gap: No reporting process for early warning (24h), notification (72h), final report (1 month).
args.recommendation: Identify the competent authority/CSIRT, define significance criteria, create templates and a named owner with deputy for 24h/72h/1-month reports, and rehearse in a tabletop exercise.

detail: Recorded assessment for NIS2-23 (not_implemented). 0 control(s) remaining.
